excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]周围有着高度异常的重力读数。

texts.zh: [From.GetName]周围有着高度异常的重力读数。

sections.zh: [From.GetName]周围有着高度异常的重力读数。

texts.zh:
在对[From.GetName]附近诡异信号进行研究的过程中，[Root.GetName]上的船员发现整个恒星系的重力分析读数高到爆表。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]怀疑[From.GetName]星门以某种方式干扰了我们的传感器，或者以某种方式造成该恒星系中隐藏着大量不可见物质。

对星门进行更深入的研究也许能带来更多的收获。
texts.en:
In studying the bizarre readings surrounding [From.GetName], the crew of the [Root.GetName] have discovered that the entire system's gravitometrics are off the charts. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suspects that the [From.GetName] gateway is somehow interfering with our sensor data, or otherwise responsible for the unaccounted-for mass in the system.

A more detailed study of the gateway may yield more insight.

texts.zh: [from.GetStarName]星系中出现了不可能的重力读数。一定是有什么东西在干扰我们的传感器。
texts.en: Impossible gravitational readings have been registered in the [from.GetStarName] system. Something must be interfering with our sensors.

texts.zh:
对[From.GetStarName]传送门的研究并不如预计的那样顺利。探测器检测到的引力效应读数远高于预估值，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]一直跟踪异常数据直达其源头，也就是某个被遗弃的时空管道的中心。他们在那里发现的一切永远的改变了他们。

在他们归来后的几天里，[Root.GetLeaderName]说在遥远星际的虚空彼端有巨大的难以描述的建筑，[Root.GetLeaderName]说那些巨大建筑发出无法抵抗的强大引力，将我们的星系拉向它们那边。

这次任务让考察队队员惊悚不已，但就在他们刚从时空管道那里回来没过不久，那异常的数据却突然消失了。
texts.en:
Examination of the [From.GetStarName] gateway did not proceed as anticipated. With sensors registering gravitational influence orders of magnitude beyond expected values, Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] chased the source to the very center of the derelict spacetime conduit. What they found there appears to have changed them.

For days following their return, [Root.GetLeaderName] spoke of massive, indescribable structures of matter in the void of space far beyond any stars. Exerting an inexorable gravitational pull, [Root.GetLeaderName] claims our galaxy streams helplessly, inevitably towards them.

The mission has left the team shaken, no less for the fact that shortly after the experience in the conduit, the abnormal readings suddenly stopped.
